dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; lateral margins are smooth and exhibit high bilateral symmetry.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to pale slate; median intensity is consistent with a sub-adult or near-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel shading concentrated primarily around the blowhole and anterior neck region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; boundaries between pigmented areas and the baseline skin tone lack sharp gradients.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, high-contrast blowhole located on the anterior dorsal midline; faint longitudinal light-tone ridge visible on the posterior third of the dorsal axis.
